parties.petitioner: Om Prakash @ Israel @ Raju @ Raju Das

summary: Plea of juvenility in criminal proceedings; constitutional mandate for recognition of juvenile status; judicial duty to actively seek truth; procedural technicalities subordinated to substantial justice; reference to Malimath Committee on active judicial role; remedial focus on socio-environmental factors in juvenile delinquency; need for equitable treatment under law; court as seeker of holistic truth.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of in light of observations on juvenility and duty to ascertain truth; specific relief not stated in excerpt.
